title: Design, synthesis and anti-cervical cancer activity of aroylpyrrole-based derivatives as potent histone deacetylase 6 inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47637-47647
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06970J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xingjie Wang, Lixuan Du, Yaxin Xue, Yitong Su, Xuetao Yuan, Shuting Yang, Weiyi Su, Wenli Gou, Xin Chen, Lu Zong
Aroylpyrrole-based derivative 10g showed an IC50 of 3.9 nM against HDAC6 and exhibited superior selectivity towards HDAC1 than clinical ACY1215. In vitro, 10g showed potent antiproliferative activity against cervical cancer cells.
